# BYMOU — International AI Creative Studio & Creative Direction

> BYMOU is an international AI creative studio founded by Mounia El. Headquartered in Marrakech, Morocco, and collaborating with clients worldwide across the United States, United Kingdom, Europe, the United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, and globally. The studio works at the intersection of human taste and creative technology, delivering AI creative direction, luxury branding, AI commercial and video production, product advertising, and 3D architectural visualization.

## Studio Overview
- **Name:** BYMOU
- **Founder & Creative Director:** Mounia El (Mounia El Oualid)
- **Headquarters:** Marrakech, Morocco
- **Geographic Reach:** Worldwide (serving clients across the US, UK, Europe, UAE, Saudi Arabia, and globally)
- **Website:** https://bymou.space

## Core Services
- [AI Film Production & Commercial Direction](https://bymou.space/ai-film-studio-marrakech): Short-form cinematic campaigns, AI video direction, narrative commercial assets.
- [Luxury Branding & Art Direction](https://bymou.space/luxury-branding-studio): Brand universe creation, visual identity systems, typography, luxury editorial direction.
- [Architectural Visualization & 3D Walkthroughs](https://bymou.space/architectural-visualization): Photorealistic unbuilt spaces, generative lighting, interior and exterior architectural rendering.
- [Real Estate Creative Marketing & Visualization](https://bymou.space/real-estate-creative-studio-marrakech): Full-stack property marketing, cinematic showcases, development presentations.
- [Hospitality Creative Studio](https://bymou.space/hospitality-creative-studio): Branding, digital presence, and guest experience visual storytelling for boutique hotels and restaurants.
- [Startup Rebranding](https://bymou.space/startup-rebranding): Strategic visual redesign, brand positioning, and digital launch systems.
- [Website Design for Hospitality & Real Estate](https://bymou.space/website-design-hospitality-real-estate): Immersive digital experiences and high-converting editorial web design.
- [AI Automation & Creative Workflows](https://bymou.space/ai-automation-morocco): Streamlined creative operations and AI-assisted content production.

## Selected Work & Case Studies
- [DEEP CUT](https://bymou.space/work/deep-cut): Five-frame speculative campaign for a fictional record club, exploring pacing, macro-groove textures, and typography.
- [Critical Charge](https://bymou.space/work/critical-charge): Independent high-drama product campaign concept and motion design.
- [Soft Glass](https://bymou.space/work/soft-glass): Speculative material exploration and digital product aesthetic study.
- [BYMOU Working Identity](https://bymou.space/work/bymou-identity): The editorial brand architecture, wordmark, and warm palette of BYMOU.
- [Full-Stack Real Estate Case Study](https://bymou.space/case-studies/ai-real-estate-marketing-marrakech): Demonstrating end-to-end architectural visualization and branding in Marrakech.

## Founder
- [About Mounia El](https://bymou.space/about): Independent creative director, artist, and founder behind BYMOU. Focuses on the philosophy: "Technology makes it possible. Taste makes it matter."
